data.name: StarBay
data.detailed_description:
Game Background

In the future, humanity accidentally captures mysterious high-dimensional dark matter clusters in the universe. To harvest this infinite energy, humanity constructs the magnificent “Interstellar Bay.”

However, immense energy always attracts greed and plunder. As a commander, you will lead special combat units powered by dark matter—“Star Troopers” and “Star Generals”—diving into this dazzling interstellar war to establish order amidst the chaos.

Gameplay

This game fuses action-shooting with strategic command. You must flexibly switch roles based on the battlefield situation:

  • Solo Hero Experience: Directly control powerful “Star Generals” to weave through bullet hells using dazzling skills. Invade enemy territory single-handedly and seize control of new sectors.

  • Strategic Command: Switch to a macro perspective to command an army of “Star Troopers” and build defense lines. Strategically deploy different unit types to intercept enemy Star Generals and protect your energy core.

  • Exploration & Progression: Explore unknown regions via the Starmap. Use resources earned from battles to upgrade your Star Generals and unlock powerful new equipment.

Art Style

The game features a minimalist sci-fi design style.

In this universe composed of spheres and geometry, the bright, elegant interface perfectly balances with spectacular particle effects during combat. Accompanied by dynamic sound effects, it offers an audio-visual feast that is both thrilling and stress-relieving.

Control powerful Star Generals in bullet-hell combat or lead Star Trooper armies to defend your base.   • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 或 AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
